 Aion 2 Korea/Taiwan Class Rework: What’s Coming to Global, What Isn’t, and How Each Class Changes
 Erik Larsson
 Created: November 11,2026 
 | Aion 2 
 | 1 views

 TL;DR: Korea and Taiwan are getting a major class and macro overhaul. Global will most likely only get it if it goes over well there. Quality-of-life changes (longer scrolls, easier dungeons) are the likeliest to reach us first. The melee classes and Chanter look hardest hit. Everything below is based on the Korea/Taiwan showcase and is informed speculation, not confirmed.
 The big picture: the macro system is changing 
 The headline change is that skills now work differently and rotations are no longer “press the same loop forever.”
 · Playing without a macro is said to deal up to 20% more damage.
 · That 20% is a ceiling, not a guarantee. Skills are fast, so most players won’t hit it. Estimate: skilled players get roughly +15%, near-perfect players get close to +20%.
 · The reworked skills and buffs may also lower your baseline damage first. Hypothetical example: a 100k DPS macro rotation drops to ~80k after the rework, and a good manual player gets back to ~90k.
 · Macros likely still exist, but charge-based and stack-based skills will be awkward to automate.
 · Open question: if the game is balanced around manual play, boss design may have to change too.
 Will we get it on Global? 
 Korea and Taiwan get balance changes first. If players there like them, Global likely follows. If the reception is bad, Global probably won’t get them.
 Likely soon (quality of life) 
 Change
 What it does
 Expected timing
 Longer scroll duration
 Scrolls last 10 minutes instead of 5 and no longer vanish when you die
 Possibly this patch or next season
 Combat/class rework
 The full rework below

 Arcana redistribution
 Pick which Arcana to farm and build multiple sets with skills on them, instead of grinding every card
 Probably with the new season
 The author reasons that Global has already received other KR/TW features, such as Abyss mode and Battlefield mode, so QoL changes tend to arrive.
 Possible, but less certain 
 · Raid reward structure: pity points shared between Normal and Hard of the same content. Global already has Normal and Hard versions of some content, so it’s plausible, but Korea and Taiwan have far more raid bosses, so it matters more for them.
 · Solo farming for normal expeditions and older dungeons. The author expects it for exploration mode and possibly Conquest Normal, since many players can’t find teams.
 Unlikely anytime soon 
 · Level cap raised to 55
 · Gear breakthrough cap going from 6 to 4 with new content materials
 · New player blessing system
 · The new KR/TW raids (Global gets its own new raid and dungeon with the new season)
 · Housing is expected relatively soon because it’s a good money maker for the game, and one more reason players will be keeping an eye on their Aion 2 Kina . Probably not this season, but well before season 4 or 5
 · Fishing, sailing, labyrinth and upper Abyss development: probably earlier than other content, but not this season
 Season timing guess 
 The author expects the new season around December 16, or the week before Christmas, because many in-game timers expire on the 16th. Not official.
 Class-by-class changes 
 The pattern across classes is that the old “reduce all skill cooldowns” specialty is replaced by stacks, charges, or resource management. Every class gets more skills in its rotation.
 Gladiator (author’s main, “hit the hardest”) 
 · Old: Overhead Slam with guaranteed crit, Lunge stance, cooldown reduction, repeat the macro.
 · New: a Frenzy system. Keep two Frenzy stacks to unlock Overhead Slam, then use the empowered version.
 · Lunge Stance cooldown reduction now only applies to Lunge Stance itself.
 · Ruinous Blow, Mocking Blade, Rush Strike, the block, and Rage Burst all generate Frenzy, so they enter the rotation.
 · Keen Strike chain means easier Frenzy management and stable damage. Rending Blow chain is more demanding.
 · Outlook: the author expects a large damage loss.

 Templar 
 · Old: a skill that enables Judgment, then spam Judgment and Execution.
 · New: Judgment becomes a charge-based skill with a 3-second recharge.
 · Use Shield Smite to enable Judgment, use it repeatedly to gain Judgment Authority, then Doom Shield fully recharges it.
 · Five consecutive uses grant Judgment Authority, which boosts offense and adds extra damage to Punishment.
 · Outlook: the author thinks it’s hard to macro and shifts the Templar toward a tank role. Proper play can deal more damage, though.
 Assassin 
 · Old: Elusive Clone, then Hardcore, then filler while Clone is on cooldown.
 · New: Elusive Clone and the Hardcore cooldown are removed. Consume five Insignia stacks to reset Ambush and gain Killing Intent. Ambush then refills Hardcore charges to max and increases Hardcore damage while the buff is active.
 · Outlook: strong in skilled hands but much harder to play.
 Ranger 
 · Basil’s Authority now reduces only its own cooldown instead of all skills.
 · Burst Arrow grants Resonance, which you need before Explosive Arrow. Landing Explosive Arrow enables Arrow Scattershot, which reduces Mastery skill cooldowns only.
 · Outlook: a big change, but less dramatic than the melee classes.
 Sorcerer 
 · The all-skill cooldown specialty is replaced by an effect that amplifies all elemental damage.
 · Skills get charges (for example, two charges of one skill, three of another), and recharge time halves at each charge state.
 · Outlook: a moderate change. The author doesn’t play Sorc and recommends checking the showcase.
 Spirit Master 
 · Similar difficulty to Ranger and Sorc. More stacks and charges to track, with the details in the showcase.
 Cleric 
 · Condemnation now activates after Chain of Torment and Deliberating Mark.
 · The cooldown-reset-on-crit specialty is replaced by an effect that amplifies all elemental damage.
 · Earth Punishment’s guaranteed Condemnation crit is replaced by faster damage-over-time ticks.
 · Outlook: a pretty big nerf overall, but it depends on actual gameplay.
 Chanter (author’s pick for “biggest loss”) 
 · Mantra movement speed merges into Undefeated Mantra, and the separate Sprint Mantra Stigma is removed.
 · A new Stigma: Storm spell boosts offense for 10 seconds while reducing healing.
 · Some major skills also get balance adjustments.
 · Outlook: the Chanter shifts from top-tier DPS toward support/buffer, and the reduced healing means you can’t do both well.
 What you should do right now 
 1. Don’t panic and don’t re-gear. Nothing is confirmed for Global, so there’s no rush to spend your Aion 2 Kina on gear for a class that may change.
 2. Expect QoL first. Longer scrolls and easier exploration farming are the most likely early arrivals.
 3. Watch KR/TW reception. If players there hate it, Global likely won’t get the rework.
 4. If you main Gladiator, Templar, Assassin, or Chanter, practice manual rotations now, since these classes need the most hand skill after the change.
 5. Plan around the likely December 16 season launch. Arcana redistribution is the biggest quality-of-life item expected then, so it’s worth getting your resources ready early, including some cheap Aion 2 Kina if you plan to stock up before the season starts.
 Source note: this summary is based on a community creator’s translation of the Korea/Taiwan showcase. Numbers like the 100k→80k→90k DPS example are the creator’s hypotheticals, not official figures.
